cookie.groupDescription: Helps us understand which channels bring visitors to our shop and which ads work. A random identifier is stored for this.
cookie.measurementDescription: A random identifier that lets us attribute visits and purchases to channels. No data is sent to advertising platforms.
cookie.marketingDescription: Purchases are reported to Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest and Awin with a hashed email address, IP address and ad cookies so they can measure and improve ads.
